mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightness condition defined by the unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of interaction-triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 2017 base level (100) signals weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction and consumer confidence, which consistently drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in rising HOUST environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of interaction-triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL between 2.0% and 3.0%) indicates a strengthening economy without excessive price pressures, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.
